name: wall-fittings-verify
description: WALL-FITTINGS: switches beside doors, sockets at skirting height, the DB box inside the main door — walk poses at Realistic, 13:00, lights on; plus an orbit frame where plates on faded walls must not float. Run with SHOT_GPU=1.

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setLightsMode?.('on'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.hideLoading?.(); s.setFeatureFlag?.('interactiveDegrade', false) })()

steps.name: probe
steps.eval: (() => { let n = 0, inst = 0; window.__three.scene.traverse(o => { if (o.name === 'wall-fittings') { n++; o.traverse(c => { if (c.isInstancedMesh) inst += c.count }) } }); console.log('[probe] fittings', JSON.stringify({ groups: n, instances: inst })) })()

steps.name: pose-bedroom2-door-from-corridor
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(5.75, 5.0); l.setYaw(0); l.setPitch(0.02) })()

steps.name: pose-living-skirting
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(10.9, 3.8); l.setYaw(-Math.PI / 2); l.setPitch(-0.35) })()

steps.name: pose-main-door
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(11.4, 6.2); l.setYaw(Math.PI); l.setPitch(0.08) })()

steps.name: pose-tv-wall
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(11.0, 2.5); l.setYaw(Math.PI / 2); l.setPitch(-0.2) })()
